<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Anirudh Kadian — Career</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  :root {
    --bg: #0d0d0d; --surface: #161616; --surface-2: #1e1e1e;
    --border: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); --border-hover: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    --text: #f0f0f0; --text-muted: #888; --text-dim: #555;
    --ac: #6366f1; --acl: #818cf8; --acbg: rgba(99,102,241,0.1); --acbd: rgba(99,102,241,0.3);
    --line: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); --r: 12px;
  }
  body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); min-height: 100vh; }

  /* Hero */
  .hero { padding: 72px 24px 56px; text-align: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .avatar-wrap { margin: 0 auto 20px; width: 96px; height: 96px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--acbd); padding: 3px; }
  .avatar-wrap img { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; object-position: top; display: block; }
  .eyebrow { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--acl); margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px); font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); line-height: 1.1; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .hero p { font-size: 15px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 24px; }
  .links { display: flex; gap: 10px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .lnk { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-hover); color: var(--text-muted); text-decoration: none; font-size: 13px; transition: border-color .15s, color .15s; }
  .lnk:hover { border-color: var(--acbd); color: var(--acl); }

  /* Nav */
  .nav { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; padding: 22px 24px 0; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .nb { padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: none; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; transition: all .15s; }
  .nb.active { border-color: var(--acbd); background: var(--acbg); color: var(--acl); }
  .nb:hover:not(.active) { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--border-hover); }

  /* Sections */
  .sec { display: none; padding: 56px 24px 80px; max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .sec.active { display: block; }
  .sec-label { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-dim); margin-bottom: 44px; text-align: center; }

  /* Timeline */
  .tl { position: relative; }
  .tl::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 1px; background: var(--line); transform: translateX(-50%); }
  .ti { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 40px 1fr; margin-bottom: 40px; align-items: start; }
  .ti:nth-child(odd) .tc  { grid-column: 1; padding-right: 20px; }
  .ti:nth-child(odd) .td  { grid-column: 2; }
  .ti:nth-child(odd) .te  { grid-column: 3; }
  .ti:nth-child(even) .te { grid-column: 1; }
  .ti:nth-child(even) .td { grid-column: 2; }
  .ti:nth-child(even) .tc { grid-column: 3; padding-left: 20px; }
  .td { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding-top: 20px; z-index: 1; }
  .tdi { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ac); border: 2px solid var(--bg); outline: 1px solid var(--ac); }
  .tc { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r); padding: 20px 22px; transition: border-color .2s; }
  .tc:hover { border-color: var(--border-hover); }
  .logo { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--acl); margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .ch { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 3px; }
  .cc { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); }
  .cp { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--surface-2); white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .cr { font-size: 12px; color: var(--acl); margin-bottom: 10px; font-weight: 500; }
  .cdiv { height: 1px; background: var(--line); margin: 10px 0; }
  .cb { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .cb li { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.55; padding-left: 13px; position: relative; }
  .cb li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 7px; width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ac); }
  .ctags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; margin-top: 12px; }
  .ctag { font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--acbg); color: var(--acl); border: 1px solid var(--acbd); }

  /* Education */
  .edu-section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; }
  .edu-heading { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 16px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .edu-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; }
  .edu-card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r); padding: 20px 22px; transition: border-color .2s; }
  .edu-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-hover); }
  .edu-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--acbg); border: 1px solid var(--acbd); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .edu-year { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .edu-degree { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 4px; line-height: 1.3; }
  .edu-school { font-size: 12px; color: var(--acl); margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 500; }
  .edu-detail { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.55; }
  .edu-tag { display: inline-block; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--acbg); color: var(--acl); border: 1px solid var(--acbd); }

  /* Certs */
  .cg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
  .cc2 { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r); padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; transition: border-color .2s; }
  .cc2:hover { border-color: var(--acbd); }
  .ci { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--acbg); border: 1px solid var(--acbd); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .cn2 { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 3px; line-height: 1.3; }
  .cm { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); }

  /* Skills */
  .sg { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 26px; }
  .sgl { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .sp { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
  .spi { padding: 6px 13px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); background: var(--surface); transition: all .15s; cursor: default; }
  .spi:hover { border-color: var(--acbd); color: var(--acl); background: var(--acbg); }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .tl::before { left: 20px; }
    .ti { grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr; }
    .ti:nth-child(odd) .tc, .ti:nth-child(even) .tc { grid-column: 2; padding: 0; }
    .ti:nth-child(odd) .td, .ti:nth-child(even) .td { grid-column: 1; }
    .ti:nth-child(odd) .te, .ti:nth-child(even) .te { display: none; }
    .edu-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="hero">
  <div class="avatar-wrap">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Anirudh Kadian" />
  </div>

<script>
function show(id, btn) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.sec').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nb').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active');
  btn.classList.add('active');
}
</script>
